title: Celestial Lotus Automaton
description: A towering humanoid figure with intricate golden mechanical armor shaped like blooming lotus flowers and gears floats dynamically in a cosmic sky. The figure holds a glowing star in its raised right hand while surrounded by shooting stars, nebulae, and swirling purple clouds.
prompt: A majestic humanoid celestial automaton with ornate golden mechanical armor designed like layered lotus petals and intricate gears, floating dynamically in a cosmic night sky filled with purple clouds, nebulae, and golden shooting stars. The figure has pale porcelain-like skin, an elaborate golden headdress with halos and floral motifs, and holds a bright glowing star in its raised right hand, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital fantasy art.
